recipes.title: Run your first architecture check
recipes.summary: Build Archguard and stop a client module from importing server code.
recipes.result: The client import below produces exit 1. Remove that import for exit 0.
recipes.boundary: Exit 2 means analysis did not complete or configuration is invalid. Source resolution does not check compiler types.

blocks.label: In your project
blocks.code:
archguard check --root . --config archguard.json
archguard check --root . --config archguard.json --json

recipes.needs: Rust 1.96+ to build. No Node installation needed for graph checks.

recipes.title: Choose the files Archguard analyzes
recipes.summary: Include application sources and their local dependencies. Leave generated files out.
recipes.result: App and shared TypeScript sources enter the graph. Generated sources do not.
recipes.boundary: An import into excluded source makes analysis incomplete. Rule and role selectors never add files to discovery.
recipes.needs: Built Archguard CLI on your PATH.

recipes.title: Resolve TypeScript aliases and package imports
recipes.summary: Use tsconfig paths, workspace package exports, and explicit source lookup settings.
recipes.result: Archguard reads nearest and inherited tsconfigs. Required external lookups fail with exit 2 when packages are missing.
recipes.boundary: Keep requireExternalResolution false for uninstalled external packages. Source lookup is separate from compiler and runtime resolution.
recipes.needs: Built Archguard CLI on your PATH.

recipes.title: Read clean, failing, and incomplete results
recipes.summary: Use completeness and the process exit code to decide the next action.
recipes.result: 0: all checks completed and passed. 1: all checks completed with violations. 2: fix config, parsing, resolution, or required facts.
recipes.boundary: An incomplete report can still contain useful findings. Dryer and mutation runs exit 0 for complete evidence, including matches or survivors.

blocks.label: Inspect completeness and findings with Node 24

recipes.needs: Built Archguard CLI on your PATH.
recipes.caption: Alternative outcomes: 0 is clean, 1 has policy violations, 2 is incomplete or invalid.

recipes.title: Keep server code out of the client
recipes.summary: Catch direct imports and indirect paths through shared modules.
recipes.result: Before: exit 1, finding client-server. After the correction: exit 0.
recipes.boundary: This checks resolved module reachability. includeTypes: false ignores erased type imports. It does not prove code executes.
recipes.needs: Built Archguard CLI on your PATH.

recipes.title: Ban an import by its written name
recipes.summary: Keep Node builtins out of browser sources, even when they are external endpoints.
recipes.result: Before: exit 1, finding browser-no-fs. After the correction: exit 0.
recipes.boundary: Specifiers match the written import string. Use forbiddenDependency for resolved file paths.
recipes.needs: Built Archguard CLI on your PATH.

recipes.title: Keep runtime calls at the application edge
recipes.summary: Report modules that call Effect.runPromise, and modules that depend on them.
recipes.result: Before: exit 1, finding domain-no-run. After the correction: exit 0.
recipes.boundary: Imported aliases are recognized; locally shadowed names are not attributed to the import. A dependency path does not prove a callback runs.
recipes.needs: Built Archguard CLI on your PATH.

recipes.title: Find dependency cycles
recipes.summary: Catch two modules that import each other before the cycle grows.
recipes.result: Before: exit 1, finding no-cycles. After the correction: exit 0.
recipes.boundary: noCycles omits literal dynamic-import edges. includeTypes: false also omits type-only edges.
recipes.needs: Built Archguard CLI on your PATH.

recipes.title: Keep a package free of a dependency
recipes.summary: Stop a domain workspace package from declaring React.
recipes.result: Before: exit 1, finding domain-no-react. After the correction: exit 0.
recipes.boundary: This checks production, peer, and optional dependencies. Development dependencies are outside the current package facts.
recipes.needs: Built Archguard CLI on your PATH.

recipes.title: Require imports through a public package entry
recipes.summary: Stop consumers from reaching into a workspace package's private source paths.
recipes.result: Before: exit 1, finding api-public-entry. After the correction: exit 0.
recipes.boundary: Include protected package sources in discovery. The allowed list checks the written specifier for imports that resolve into those sources.
recipes.needs: Built Archguard CLI on your PATH.
recipes.caption: A consumer can import @app/api. An import directly into private source is blocked.

recipes.title: Require a named export
recipes.summary: Make every adapter expose a create function.
recipes.result: Before: exit 1, finding adapter-create. After the correction: exit 0.
recipes.boundary: Each name needs one visible export origin. This checks presence, not the function signature; external star exports are not enumerated.
recipes.needs: Built Archguard CLI on your PATH.

recipes.title: Require an analyzed source file
recipes.summary: Require a contracts entry point to exist in the selected source inventory.
recipes.result: Before: exit 1, finding contracts-entry. After the correction: exit 0.
recipes.boundary: Every configured pattern must match an analyzed source. This cannot require a README or another unsupported non-source file.
recipes.needs: Built Archguard CLI on your PATH.

recipes.title: Use namespace imports for Effect services
recipes.summary: Keep a service and its layer under one module name at call sites.
recipes.result: Before: exit 1, finding service-namespace. After the correction: exit 0.
recipes.boundary: Only recognized Effect service syntax and value consumers are checked. This is an import convention.

recipes.title: Catch duplicate Effect service identifiers
recipes.summary: Give each recognized service its own literal identifier.
recipes.result: Before: exit 1, finding unique-service-id. After the correction: exit 0.
recipes.boundary: Computed identifiers and arbitrary service factories are outside the recognized syntax.

recipes.title: Give every source file exactly one role
recipes.summary: Catch sources that fall outside your conventions or match overlapping roles.
recipes.result: Before: exit 1, finding classify-source. After the correction: exit 0.
recipes.boundary: Roles filter selected sources. A classification rule chooses where exactly-one membership is required.

recipes.summary: Require src/layers/Orders.ts whenever src/services/Orders.ts is analyzed.
recipes.result: Before: exit 1, finding service-companion. After the correction: exit 0.
recipes.boundary: The replacement string must occur exactly once. The companion must be analyzed; presence does not prove it implements the service.

recipes.title: Require a registry to import every migration
recipes.summary: Catch a new migration with no static value import in the registry.
recipes.result: Before: exit 1, finding migration-import. After the correction: exit 0.
recipes.boundary: Dynamic imports, require calls, type imports, and re-exports do not qualify. This checks imports, not registry membership or execution.

recipes.summary: Keep contracts independent of host implementation code.
recipes.result: Before: exit 1, finding contracts-no-host. After the correction: exit 0.
recipes.boundary: Role exclusions affect source and target membership. Transitive paths can pass through modules with no role.

recipes.title: Check an inferred public member

recipes.boundary: Use a compatible already installed one-shot runner. The adapter was checked with Vitest 5.0.1. It does not install or discover tests, and watch mode is unsupported.

recipes.title: Bound a mutation run
recipes.summary: Set a small mutation budget, worker count, deadline, and workspace ceiling.
recipes.result: Limits bound trusted command execution. Reaching an analysis or execution limit remains visible in completeness and problems.
recipes.boundary: Worker copies and limits are not an arbitrary-code sandbox. Address-space limits are Linux-only. SIGINT and SIGTERM request bounded cleanup.
recipes.needs: Start with a complete mutation configuration from the run or Vitest recipe. This is a limits fragment.

recipes.title: Reuse complete mutation results
recipes.summary: Opt into conservative result reuse when every relevant test input is declared and deterministic.
recipes.result: Unchanged declared inputs can reuse complete killed and survived results. Changing tests, helpers, dependencies, or other declared inputs invalidates reuse.
recipes.boundary: Keep state outside source and dependency inputs. Leave reuse off for network, clock, or undeclared host dependencies. Cleanup uncertainty prevents reuse.

recipes.title: Have your agent try Archguard on a repository
recipes.summary: Install the evaluation skill and give your agent a time, disk, and change budget.
recipes.result: The agent proposes architecture checks and duplicate improvements, publishes an authorized draft PR, and adds mutation evidence when available.
recipes.boundary: The skill supplies instructions, not the CLI or dependencies. Per-test attribution uses experimental research tooling when suitable; the product reporter gives aggregate evidence.
